Method of Attack: XSS payload used to inject malicious code into Magento store footer to steal payment card data
Impacted Systems: Magento sites running Mirasvit Helpdesk extension
Attack Vector: Malicious code injected via chat widget in Mirasvit Helpdesk extension
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious XSS payload stored in Magento database via chat widget
Malicious code executed in store footer on all pages
Payload published on GitHub by de Groot
